paite: Bangchiteng a ding in hunbi a om, van nuai a thiltup chiteng a ding in hun;
heading: Bang Teng A Dia Hunbi

paite: Pian hun leh sih hun; suan hun leh suansa bohkhiak hun;
Thah hun leh hihdam hun; phel hun leh lam nawn hun;
Kah hun leh nuih hun; suun hun leh lam hun;
Suangte paihmang hun leh suangte lakkhawm hun; kawi hun leh kawi kidek hun;
Zon hun leh mansuah hun; vom hun leh paihmang hun;
Bohkek hun leh khui hun; pau louh hun leh thugen hun;
It hun leh muhdah hun; kidou hun leh kilep hun.
Asepgimna nasempa'n bang phattuamna anei a?
Huai akisawizoina ding a Pathian in mite tapate kiang a apiak haksatna ka muta hi.
Thil chiteng ahun a kilawm in abawl a; alungtang uah khovel leng akoihta a, hinapi in mihing in Pathian nasep abul a kipan a atawp pha ahihsa amukhe thei kei hi.
Adamsung teng un kipah leh hoih hih sang a amau a dia hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei chih ka thei hi.
Michih in anek a adawn a, asepgimna tengteng a hoih leh nuam asakpih Pathian thilpiak ahi.

Bangpeuh Pathian in ahih, tangtawn in a-om ding chih ka thei a; huai ah bangmah akikoih thei kei ding a, huai a kipan in bangmah mah akilakhe thei sam kei ding; Pathian in ahih khinta a, huchi in ama ah mite'n alau ding uhi.
A-om khinsa pen; a-om ding a om khinsa ahi; huan Pathian in apaimangsa azong hi.
Huchi in ni nuai ah, vaihawmna mun ah, gitlouhna a-om chih leng ka mu hi; huan diktatna mun ah, gitlouhna huai ah a-om hi.
heading: Leitung A Diklouhna

paite: Ka lungtang in, "Pathian in midiktat leh migilou angaihtuah ding; thiltup chiteng leh nasep chiteng a ding in hun a-om," ka chi hi.
Ka lungtang in, mite tapate ziak in ahi, Pathian in amau a-ettel a, amau mahmah gamsa bang lel ahihdan uh akitheihtheihna ding un.

Mite tapate tung atung peuhmah lah gamsate tung ah atung ngal a; thil khat ngei atung uah atung a; khat asih bang in, huchi mah bang in adangdang asi a; ahi, hu khat aneikhawm ua; huan mihing in gamsate sang a masak zawkna anei kei; bang teng bangmah lou ahi ngal a.
Bang teng mun khat ah apai ua; bang teng leivui a kipan ahi ua, bang teng leivui ah akik nawn uh.
Mihing kha tunglam a paitouleh gamsa kha nuailam a paisuk ahihdan kua ahia thei?
Huaiziak in mihing a nasepte a akipah ding sang a hoihzaw bangmah a-om kei chih ka thei hi; huai atantuan ahi ngal a; amah nung in bang ahi dia chih mu ding in amah kua'n hon pi nawn ahia le?
